name: @open-archiver/mcp-server
description: Read-only MCP server that exposes an Open Archiver archive to AI clients through the REST API

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
